full_page.content:
1945, October
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal letter by the Servant of God Fr. Solanus Casey OFM, Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN 7, N.Y. Oct. 1, 1945
Mrs. Helen Skonieczny 64 12 Joseph Campau Detroit, Michigan
Dear Mrs. Skonieczny:
God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your charitable and generous favor of almost a month ago. I remember you and your pecu- liar case very well. I surely am pleased that things have adjusted themselves so well. God in His wisdom and mercy working so favor- ably in all. I hope too that your Husband has arrived back by now. Please pardon delay.
God bless both of you
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
(also written on a Seraphic Mass Association Card) Stanley and Helen Skonieczny July 29, 1954 Fr. Solanus O.F.M.Cap:
Bless'd God! Show Thy mercy and holy countenance.
Originals are in the possession of S.J. Skonieczny 35129 W. Chicago Blvd. Livonia, Michigan 48150
